WITH per_pair AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
  GROUP BY o.mktnote
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_rate
  FROM per_pair
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.mean_pair_rate AS excess_rate
  FROM per_pair AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE b.mean_pair_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.mean_pair_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(excess_rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
